_about: Where Word 16.106 wrapped each paragraph of tools/make_wrap_kern_probe.py -- a word in a text width set to its plain, legacy-kerned and GPOS-kerned width give or take a fraction of a point, with w:kern and without -- the lines it drew, the width of each word it kept on one line (pt), and the advances and kern pairs of each word in the faces Word lays out with (font units). Measurements only; regenerate with tools/read_wrap_kern_probe.py --record.
